import math
import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict

from solution import bucket_metrics


class BucketMetricsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_buckets_in_both_required_orders(self):
        thresholds = OrderedDict([('latency', 10), ('score', 0.5)])
        entries = [
            {'id': 'b', 'metrics': {'latency': 9, 'score': 0.5}},
            {'id': 'a', 'metrics': {'latency': 10, 'score': 0.49}},
            {'id': 'c', 'metrics': {'latency': 20, 'score': 0.9}},
        ]
        result = bucket_metrics(entries, thresholds)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ['latency', 'score'])
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            'latency': {'below': ['b'], 'at_or_above': ['a', 'c']},
            'score': {'below': ['a'], 'at_or_above': ['b', 'c']},
        })
        self.assertEqual(entries[0]['metrics'], {'latency': 9, 'score': 0.5})
        self.assertEqual(list(thresholds), ['latency', 'score'])

    def test_empty_entries_and_fresh_nested_containers(self):
        result = bucket_metrics([], {'x': 1, 'y': 2})
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            'x': {'below': [], 'at_or_above': []},
            'y': {'below': [], 'at_or_above': []},
        })
        self.assertIsNot(result['x'], result['y'])
        self.assertIsNot(result['x']['below'], result['y']['below'])
        self.assertIsNot(result['x']['below'], result['x']['at_or_above'])

    def test_rejects_malformed_thresholds_and_entries(self):
        cases = [
            ([], {}),
            ([], {'': 1}),
            ([], {'x': True}),
            ([], {'x': float('inf')}),
            ([], {'x': float('nan')}),
            ([{'id': 1}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 1, 'metrics': {'x': 2}, 'extra': 3}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': [], 'metrics': {'x': 2}}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 1, 'metrics': {}}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 1, 'metrics': {'x': 2, 'y': 3}}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 1, 'metrics': {'x': True}}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 1, 'metrics': {'x': float('-inf')}}], {'x': 0}),
            ([{'id': 'same', 'metrics': {'x': 1}},
              {'id': 'same', 'metrics': {'x': 2}}], {'x': 0}),
        ]
        for entries, thresholds in cases:
            with self.subTest(entries=entries, thresholds=thresholds):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    bucket_metrics(entries, thresholds)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
